name: Grant-In-Aid to Tripura and Mizoram for Rehabilitation of Bru Migrants
benefit: Fixed Deposits @ ₹4,00,000 Per FamilyMonthly Cash Assistance @ ₹5,000 Per FamilyFree Ration for 2 YearsHouse Building Assistance @ ₹1,50,000 Per FamilyLand Plots @ 30x40 Sq. Ft. Free Transportation to the Place of Resettlement
eligibility_rules: The applicant should be Bru (Reang) families who migrated to North Tripura due to ethnic violence in Mizoram and should have expressed a desire to settle in Tripura.
how_to_apply: Mode: OnlineStep 1: Register on the ServicePlus Portal. Verify your Email ID and Mobile Number via OTP.Step 2: Login to the ServicePlus Portal using the Username and Password received over your registered Email ID.Step 3: In the Left Pane, click "Apply for Service" and then click on "View All Available Services".Step 4: From the list, click on "BRU DBT Relief Rehabilitation".Step 5: You will be directed to the application form. Fill in all the mandatory fields (highlighted in a red asterisk).Step 6: Click "Submit". Note down the Application ID/ Reference ID to track the status of your application.
